data.description:
## Description

**What**: Ship plugins/dso/scripts/lib/strata-config-defaults.conf and plugins/dso/scripts/lib/strata-template-vars.sh as canonical definition files. The defaults file maps each Strata template variant (rails, nextjs, flask) to commands.* values, Rails-Strata ARCH_ENFORCEMENT footguns, and Strata Posture section template. The vars file lists upstream copier.yml required vars (name + type + accepted-values) pinned to upstream commit hashes (per spike: v1.0.0 for template-application-rails).
**Why**: A1 must NOT independently define commands.* keys (that's A2 territory beyond seeded values). Single source of truth eliminates drift between A1's install-time writes and A2's onboarding-time idempotency check.
**Scope**:
- IN: strata-config-defaults.conf with commands.* per template, footguns block per template, full Posture section template (uses install-time-known _commit and _src_path); strata-template-vars.sh with hardcoded required-var list pinned to upstream tag/commit (v1.0.0 for Rails template); both files documented as single-source-of-truth and contract-stable for A2 to source.
- OUT: Sourcing logic in apply-overlay (separate story); A2 onboarding consumption (different epic).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, plugins/dso/scripts/lib/strata-config-defaults.conf exists and contains commands.*, footguns, and Posture template per Strata variant ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, plugins/dso/scripts/lib/strata-template-vars.sh exists with required-var list pinned to v1.0.0 ← Satisfies: SC3
- When complete, behavioral test asserts the file values produce zero diff against A2's onboarding-time idempotency check on the same scaffolded project state ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for parsing/sourcing the defaults file

## Considerations
- [Maintainability] Document contract stability — A2 depends on schema; bump only with both-epic coordination
- [Reliability] Pin every upstream reference to a tag/commit; never to a moving branch

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an installer + onboarding consumer, a shared strata-config-defaults file is the single source of truth for commands.* + Posture + footguns
